title: A day at your nursery, from open to close
lead: Your nursery already has a system. It is a WhatsApp group. Here is the same day, without it.
timelineLabel: A day at your nursery, hour by hour

items.title: Drop-off
items.body: Drop-off. A parent taps check-in from the gate. The button only works inside 100 metres. No book, no queue, no tablet.
items.alt: Parent app showing today's attendance with a Check In button

items.title: Room overview
items.body: The room, at a glance. The teacher sees who is in, who is late, who is out. Manual mark in one tap.
items.alt: Teacher view of the class attendance list with a Mark as Checked-in button

items.title: Photos
items.body: Photos, in the right album. Each photo goes to that child's own gallery, not a group where twelve families scroll to find their own.
items.alt: Media gallery screen showing the day's photos of a child

items.title: Daily activities
items.body: Logged as it happens. Meals, nap, mood, nappies, medication. Recorded in the moment, not from memory at half past four.
items.alt: Child Daily Logs screen with mood options

items.title: Parent check-in
items.body: A parent checks in. From her desk, without messaging anyone, she sees what her child ate, how long she slept, and this morning's photos.
items.alt: Parent app home screen beside the day details with meals, nap and photos

items.title: Daily report
items.body: One tap, and the day is sent. Every parent gets a notification in their own language. Filed for good, searchable next year.
items.alt: Draft daily log screen beside a Published Successfully confirmation

items.title: Stay connected
items.body: The conversation stays in one place. Parents message the nursery directly, follow up on their child’s day, and keep every update in the same chat.
items.alt: A parent holding a phone that shows a chat with the nursery

summary.title: The day, all in one place
summary.body: Nothing lost in a group chat. Nothing written twice. Nothing arriving at midnight.
summary.alt: Notices, a class update and an attendance overview above the Yawmy Care app
